settings.headline: Track Your Order
settings.subheadline: Enter your order number and email to check your shipment status.

settings.helper_text: We don't have a live tracking app connected yet. Submitting this form takes you to your account's order history — for the fastest update, check the shipping confirmation email we sent you.

settings.question: Order hasn't arrived?
settings.answer: Shipping times can vary depending on your location. If your order hasn't arrived within the estimated delivery window, check your shipping confirmation email for tracking details, or reach out and we'll look into it for you.

settings.question: Wrong address?
settings.answer: If you entered the wrong shipping address, contact us as soon as possible after placing your order. We can update it before it ships, but once an order has shipped we're unable to redirect it.

settings.question: How do I contact support?
settings.answer: Email us anytime at support@renivacare.com or use our contact form, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
